Reconciliation_Name: Trial Balance to General Ledger Tie-Out
Objective: Verify that the prepared Trial Balance mathematically equals the sum of all transactional debits and credits in the General Ledger by account and period.
Fields_Or_Balances_Compared: Account Code, Account Name, Net Period Movement, Ending Balance, Debit Sum, Credit Sum
Period_And_Entity_Coverage: Monthly for all in-scope historical periods (LTM/3Y) across all legal entities
Detailed_Procedure: Aggregate GL detail by Account Code and Fiscal Period; compute Net Movement = Sum(Debit) - Sum(Credit); join on TB by Account Code; compute Variance = GL Net Movement - TB Period Movement.
Common_Discrepancies: Direct manual journal entries posted after TB extraction; unposted or draft journals; orphan GL accounts missing from TB export; date filter mismatches (posting date vs transaction date).
Investigative_Steps: Filter GL for unposted/draft status; verify extraction timestamps; run SQL outer join to detect orphan account codes; audit journal entry log for entries made post-close.
Required_Supporting_Evidence: EVD-001 (ERP system generated extraction logs, timestamped journal audit trail)
Source_References: AICPA Audit Data Standards GL Ledger Standard Section 3.2; PwC TAS Manual

Reconciliation_Name: Trial Balance to Monthly Management Accounts Reconciliation
Objective: Establish whether internal monthly P&L and Balance Sheet reporting packages presented to the Board agree with the underlying transactional Trial Balance.
Source_Records_Required: SRC-001 (Prepared TB), SRC-003 (Monthly Management Accounts / Board Deck)
Fields_Or_Balances_Compared: Monthly Revenues, COGS, Gross Profit, Operating Expenses by department, EBITDA, Net Working Capital, Cash
Period_And_Entity_Coverage: Monthly for all historical periods under diligence (24 to 36 months) for consolidated group and operating subsidiaries
Detailed_Procedure: Map TB accounts to management reporting line items using Standardized Chart of Accounts; aggregate TB balances; compare against monthly management pack line-by-line; calculate variance; identify management consolidation or reporting adjustments.
Expected_Result: Zero variance or fully identified and supported management reporting adjustments.
Common_Discrepancies: Off-ledger management adjustments; Excel spreadsheet formula overrides; unrecorded accruals made in management decks but not booked in ERP; timing differences in month-end cut-off; topside entries.
Investigative_Steps: Request monthly bridge schedules from CFO; inspect management journal entries; trace board deck figures to underlying GL trial balance; verify if adjustments were ever posted to GL.
Required_Supporting_Evidence: EVD-002 (CFO month-end closing workbooks, executive presentation workpapers, ERP journal vouchers)
Source_References: ICAEW Guidelines on Due Diligence; Alvarez & Marsal TAS Methodology

Reconciliation_Name: Management Accounts to Audited / Statutory Financial Statements Bridge
Objective: Reconcile full-year management accounts against annual audited statutory financial statements to identify audit adjustments and assess reliability of interim reporting.
Source_Records_Required: SRC-003 (12-Month Management Accounts), SRC-004 (Audited Financial Statements & Auditor AJE Log)
Fields_Or_Balances_Compared: Annual Revenue, Cost of Sales, Gross Margin, Operating Expenses, Operating Income, EBT, Net Income, Total Assets, Total Liabilities, Equity
Period_And_Entity_Coverage: Annual for each audited fiscal year within the historical period (FY-3, FY-2, FY-1)
Detailed_Procedure: Sum monthly management accounts for the 12-month fiscal year; align line items with audited balance sheet and income statement; compute variances; obtain auditor Schedule of Unadjusted Audit Differences (SUM) and recorded AJEs; map each audit adjustment to variance lines.
Expected_Result: 100% of variance explained by documented audit adjustments and GAAP reclassifications.
Common_Discrepancies: Cut-off errors reversed by auditors; lower of cost or market inventory write-downs; bad debt provision increases; unrecorded bonus or legal accruals; revenue recognition corrections; deferred tax adjustments.
Investigative_Steps: Inspect independent auditor management letter and AJEs; determine whether audit adjustments were rolled back into subsequent year management books or left as permanent disconnects; assess control deficiency impact.
Required_Supporting_Evidence: EVD-003 (Auditor Signed Opinion, Auditor AJE Schedule, Auditor Management Letter)
Expected_Workpaper: REC-003 (Mgmt Accounts to Audited FS Bridge)
Source_References: AICPA AU-C Section 265; BDO Transaction Advisory Guidelines

Reconciliation_Name: Corporate Group Consolidation & Intercompany Elimination Reconciliation
Objective: Verify that all intercompany transactions (sales, purchases, management fees, interest, dividends) and reciprocal balances (receivables, payables, loans) eliminate to exactly zero across legal entities.
Source_Records_Required: SRC-001 (Entity-level TBs), SRC-005 (Consolidation Workbooks & Elimination Journals)
Fields_Or_Balances_Compared: Intercompany AR vs AP, Intercompany Revenue vs Expense, Intercompany Loan Receivable vs Note Payable, Unrealized Profit in Inventory
Period_And_Entity_Coverage: Monthly and annual across all legal entities within the acquisition perimeter
Detailed_Procedure: Extract intercompany account balances for each entity pair; construct an N x N intercompany matrix; calculate bilateral differences (Entity A Receivable vs Entity B Payable); identify uneliminated residuals; evaluate FX translation methodologies; test for unrealized margin in ending inventory.
Expected_Result: Net intercompany balance across all reciprocal accounts must equal 0.00 upon consolidation.
Common_Discrepancies: Timing differences (goods or cash in transit across borders); FX translation mismatches (different currency rates applied by subsidiaries); one-sided billings without counterparty accrual; uneliminated inventory profit plugs.
Investigative_Steps: Inspect shipping manifests for goods in transit; inspect bank wires for cash in transit; verify currency revaluation entries; recalculate internal transfer markups embedded in ending inventory.
Required_Supporting_Evidence: EVD-004 (Entity-pair confirmation statements, cross-border shipping documents, intercompany loan agreements)
Source_References: US GAAP ASC 810 (Consolidation); IFRS 10; Kroll Due Diligence Practice

Reconciliation_Name: Revenue & Sales Subledger to General Ledger Reconciliation
Objective: Tie out gross sales, credit notes, discounts, and net revenue recorded in the transactional sales subledger / billing system to GL revenue accounts.
Source_Records_Required: SRC-006 (Sales Register / Subledger), SRC-001 (TB), SRC-002 (GL Detail)
Fields_Or_Balances_Compared: Invoice Date, Customer ID, Invoice Number, Gross Sales, Returns, Allowances, Net Revenue, Sales Tax, Freight Billed
Period_And_Entity_Coverage: Monthly for all historical periods by revenue stream and entity
Detailed_Procedure: Aggregate sales register transactions by GL posting account and calendar month; reconcile to credits in GL revenue accounts; identify non-sales credits or manual debit adjustments; test sales cut-off at period boundaries.
Expected_Result: Subledger net sales equals GL revenue exactly (Variance == 0.00).
Common_Discrepancies: Bill-and-hold transactions excluded from subledger; manual journal entries debiting/crediting revenue directly; credit memos unapplied; deferred revenue manual overrides; sales tax included in sales ledger but separated in GL.
Investigative_Steps: Filter GL revenue accounts for manual journal vouchers; inspect sales register invoice status flags; sample invoices near month-end dates; verify cash collection post-close.
Required_Supporting_Evidence: EVD-005 (Transactional billing reports, ERP sales registers, proof of delivery / bills of lading)
Source_References: AICPA Audit Guide for Revenue Recognition; PwC FDD Manual

Reconciliation_Name: Accounts Receivable Subledger Aging to General Ledger Control Tie-Out
Objective: Reconcile open customer balances per the detailed AR aging report to the GL trade receivables control account (A/C 1-1100).
Source_Records_Required: SRC-007 (Detailed AR Aging by Customer), SRC-001 (TB), SRC-002 (GL)
Fields_Or_Balances_Compared: Customer ID, Current, 1-30, 31-60, 61-90, 91-120, Over 120 Days, Total AR Balance, GL Control Balance
Period_And_Entity_Coverage: Monthly at each fiscal balance sheet date across all operating entities
Detailed_Procedure: Run AR aging report as-of the exact fiscal period end date; sum all customer outstanding balances; compare total to GL account 1-1100 balance; identify unreconciled breaks; isolate unapplied credits and manual control entries.
Expected_Result: AR subledger total equals GL control account balance exactly.
Common_Discrepancies: Manual journal entries posted directly to the GL AR control account; backdated invoices posted into closed periods; unapplied cash receipts floating in suspense; credit balances in AR that should be reclassified to liabilities.
Investigative_Steps: Inspect GL control account for entries not originating from the AR sales/cash subledger module; review unapplied cash suspense accounts; cross-reference customer disputes.
Required_Supporting_Evidence: EVD-006 (Detailed AR aging as of balance sheet dates, bank deposit slips, customer dispute files)
Expected_Workpaper: REC-006 (AR Aging to GL Control Schedule)
Source_References: Microsoft Dynamics D365 Customer-to-Ledger Guide; RSM FDD Methodology

Reconciliation_Name: Accounts Payable Subledger Aging to General Ledger Control Tie-Out
Objective: Reconcile open vendor liabilities per the detailed AP aging report and Goods Received Not Invoiced (GRNI) register to the GL trade payables control accounts.
Source_Records_Required: SRC-008 (Detailed AP Aging by Vendor), SRC-009 (GRNI Register), SRC-001 (TB)
Fields_Or_Balances_Compared: Vendor ID, Current, 1-30, 31-60, 61-90, 91-120, Over 120 Days, Total AP Balance, GRNI Accrual Balance, GL Trade AP Balance
Period_And_Entity_Coverage: Monthly at each fiscal balance sheet date across all operating entities
Detailed_Procedure: Run AP aging report as of balance sheet date; sum vendor balances; extract GRNI clearing report; compare sum of AP + GRNI to GL accounts 2-1000 and 2-1050; identify breaks; analyze aged unvouchered receipts.
Expected_Result: Subledger AP plus valid GRNI equals GL control balance exactly.
Common_Discrepancies: Manual journal entries posted directly to trade AP; old unvouchered GRNI receipts that were never invoiced or reversed; debit balances in AP (vendor advances/credits); unrecorded liabilities at cut-off.
Investigative_Steps: Inspect GL AP accounts for manual journal vouchers; inspect GRNI items older than 60 days; review post-period disbursements for unrecorded liabilities.
Required_Supporting_Evidence: EVD-007 (Detailed AP aging as of balance sheet dates, GRNI open PO reports, vendor statement reconciliations)
Expected_Workpaper: REC-007 (AP Aging and GRNI to GL Control Schedule)
Source_References: AICPA Audit Data Standards Purchasing Subledger; Houlihan Lokey TAS

Reconciliation_Name: Inventory Subledger / Valuation to General Ledger Roll-Forward
Objective: Reconcile perpetual inventory subledger valuation by SKU/location to GL inventory asset accounts and verify cost of sales roll-forward.
Source_Records_Required: SRC-010 (Inventory Valuation Report / Stock Ledger), SRC-001 (TB), SRC-011 (Physical Stock Count Sheets)
Fields_Or_Balances_Compared: SKU, Item Description, Category, Quantity on Hand, Unit Cost, Extended Value, Location, GL Inventory Balance
Period_And_Entity_Coverage: Monthly / quarterly at period-end dates for inventory-holding entities
Detailed_Procedure: Sum inventory valuation report across Raw Materials, WIP, and Finished Goods; compare to GL accounts 1-1200, 1-1210, 1-1220; roll forward inventory: Beginning Inventory + Purchases/Production - COGS = Ending Inventory; analyze stock count variances.
Expected_Result: Inventory valuation report equals GL inventory asset accounts exactly.
Common_Discrepancies: Unrecorded scrap or shrinkage; standard cost variance adjustments unposted; goods in transit recorded twice or omitted; negative inventory balances; lower-of-cost-or-market reserves unadjusted.
Investigative_Steps: Inspect year-end physical inventory count sheets; trace count discrepancies to GL write-downs; verify standard cost update logs; examine freight/overhead capitalized into inventory.
Required_Supporting_Evidence: EVD-008 (Perpetual inventory stock status reports, physical stocktake count sheets, standard cost update logs)
Source_References: AICPA Audit Guide for Inventory; EY TAS Technical Reference

Reconciliation_Name: Bank Statement to General Ledger Cash Four-Column Proof of Cash
Objective: Verify cash balances, total cash receipts, and total cash disbursements between third-party bank statements and the general ledger over historical periods.
Source_Records_Required: SRC-012 (Bank Statements), SRC-013 (Bank Reconciliation Reports), SRC-002 (GL Cash Account)
Fields_Or_Balances_Compared: Beginning Cash Balance, Monthly Cash Deposits, Monthly Cash Withdrawals, Ending Cash Balance, Deposits in Transit, Outstanding Checks, Bank Fees
Period_And_Entity_Coverage: Monthly for selected focus periods (e.g. LTM, year-end months) across all operational bank accounts
Detailed_Procedure: Construct 4-column matrix: Beginning Balance, Receipts, Disbursements, Ending Balance; enter unadjusted bank figures; apply reconciling items (DIT, OC, bank errors); enter unadjusted book figures; apply book adjustments (interest, fees, unrecorded wires); tie out across all 4 columns.
Expected_Result: Reconciled Bank figures equal Reconciled Book figures across all 4 columns (Variance == 0.00).
Common_Discrepancies: Stale outstanding checks never written back; unrecorded bank charges; timing float anomalies; potential cash kiting or lapping; unrecorded customer payments; hidden overdrafts.
Investigative_Steps: Obtain independent bank confirmation letters; trace deposits in transit to subsequent bank statements (cleared within 3-5 days); verify outstanding checks clearing post-close; inspect wire confirmations.
Required_Supporting_Evidence: EVD-009 (Official bank statements, bank confirmation letters, subsequent clearing bank statements)
Source_References: AICPA AU-C Section 505 (External Confirmations); Kroll Forensic Practice

Reconciliation_Name: Payroll Census & Tax Filings (Form 941/W-2) to General Ledger Payroll Reconciliation
Objective: Reconcile gross payroll, payroll taxes, employee benefits, and accrued bonuses from third-party payroll processor registers and quarterly tax filings to GL payroll expense accounts.
Source_Records_Required: SRC-014 (Payroll Census & Processor Summary), SRC-015 (IRS Form 941 / State Tax Filings), SRC-001 (TB)
Fields_Or_Balances_Compared: Gross Wages, Employer FICA/Medicare, SUTA/FUTA, 401(k) Match, Health Insurance, Accrued Bonus, Total Compensation Expense
Period_And_Entity_Coverage: Annual and quarterly for all historical periods under diligence
Detailed_Procedure: Sum total gross wages and employer taxes from quarterly payroll processor reports (or Form 941 Box 2 & 5a); compare against GL direct and indirect compensation expense accounts; reconcile payroll liability clearing accounts (A/C 2-2000).
Expected_Result: Payroll reports tie to GL compensation accounts within immaterial rounding (<).
Common_Discrepancies: Severance payments booked to legal expense; owner discretionary personal distributions run through payroll; off-payroll contractor wages; unaccrued year-end bonuses; accrued vacation liability understated.
Investigative_Steps: Inspect third-party payroll provider annual tax summaries (e.g. ADP/Gusto/Paychex annual reports); match quarterly Form 941 total wages to P&L; verify bonus approval minutes.
Required_Supporting_Evidence: EVD-010 (Form 941 quarterly returns, ADP/Gusto annual wage reports, employee census file)
Expected_Workpaper: REC-010 (Payroll to GL & Tax Filing Bridge)
Procedure_Classification: Supporting Accounting Control / Core QoE Procedure
Source_References: AICPA Employee Benefit Plans Guide; FTI Consulting FDD Practice

Reconciliation_Name: Fixed Asset Register (FAR) to General Ledger & Depreciation Roll-Forward
Objective: Reconcile gross fixed assets, accumulated depreciation, and current-period depreciation expense per the detailed FAR to GL asset and expense accounts.
Source_Records_Required: SRC-016 (Detailed Fixed Asset Register), SRC-001 (TB), SRC-002 (GL)
Fields_Or_Balances_Compared: Asset Tag, Description, Acquisition Date, Capitalized Cost, Useful Life, Depreciation Method, Prior Accumulated Depreciation, Current Depreciation, Net Book Value
Period_And_Entity_Coverage: Annual and LTM across all entities with material CapEx
Detailed_Procedure: Roll forward gross fixed assets: Beginning Cost + Additions - Disposals = Ending Cost; roll forward accumulated depreciation: Beginning Acc Dep + Depreciation Expense - Disposal Back-out = Ending Acc Dep; compare ending balances to GL balance sheet accounts.
Expected_Result: FAR gross cost and accumulated depreciation tie to GL exactly.
Common_Discrepancies: Ghost assets (assets physically retired or scrapped but retained on FAR); repairs and maintenance expensed that should be capitalized or vice versa; depreciation calculated on accelerated tax basis instead of GAAP straight-line; missing disposal records.
Investigative_Steps: Sample major CapEx invoices (>materiality threshold); inspect disposal documentation and proceeds; verify asset physical existence during site visits; check depreciation convention consistency.
Required_Supporting_Evidence: EVD-011 (Detailed asset register, vendor CapEx equipment invoices, scrap/disposal certificates)
Expected_Workpaper: REC-011 (Fixed Asset and Depreciation Roll-Forward Schedule)
Source_References: US GAAP ASC 360 (Property, Plant, and Equipment); PwC TAS CapEx Guide

Reconciliation_Name: Debt Schedule & Lender Confirmations to General Ledger Notes Payable
Objective: Reconcile outstanding principal, accrued interest, interest expense, and debt covenants per third-party loan statements to GL liability accounts.
Source_Records_Required: SRC-017 (Credit Agreements & Lender Statements), SRC-001 (TB), SRC-002 (GL)
Fields_Or_Balances_Compared: Lender Name, Facility Type, Original Principal, Maturity Date, Interest Rate, Period Payments, Ending Principal, Accrued Interest, Debt Issuance Costs
Period_And_Entity_Coverage: Quarterly and at each balance sheet date for all interest-bearing debt
Detailed_Procedure: Roll forward debt balances: Beginning Debt + New Borrowings - Principal Repayments = Ending Debt; calculate expected interest expense = Average Debt * Effective Interest Rate; compare to GL interest expense and accrued interest accounts; test debt covenant ratios.
Expected_Result: Debt schedule ending principal ties to GL notes payable and 3rd-party statements.
Common_Discrepancies: Unrecorded shareholder loans; capital leases omitted from debt; debt issuance costs improperly expensed immediately; unaccrued interest or penalty fees; covenant breaches masked by year-end prepayments.
Investigative_Steps: Obtain independent bank loan confirmation letters; review credit agreements and amendments; inspect lender payoff statements for closing debt settlement.
Required_Supporting_Evidence: EVD-012 (Lender monthly statements, executed credit agreements, debt confirmation certificates)
Source_References: AICPA AU-C Section 505; Alvarez & Marsal Debt Diligence

Reconciliation_Name: Tax Return (Form 1120/1065 Schedule M-1/M-3) to Financial Statement Net Income Reconciliation
Objective: Reconcile book net income per audited/prepared financial statements to taxable income per corporate income tax returns, categorizing permanent and temporary differences.
Source_Records_Required: SRC-018 (Filed Federal Income Tax Returns Form 1120/1065 Schedule M-1/M-3), SRC-004 (Audited/Management FS)
Fields_Or_Balances_Compared: Line 1 Net Income per Books, Permanent Differences (Meals, Fines, Tax-Exempt Interest), Temporary Differences (Depreciation, Bad Debt, Bonus Accrual), Taxable Income
Period_And_Entity_Coverage: Annual for all closed tax years within the diligence period (typically 3-5 years)
Detailed_Procedure: Compare Book Net Income on Schedule M-1 Line 1 / Schedule M-3 Part I Line 11 to Financial Statement Net Income; analyze line-by-line differences; verify whether differences are legitimate tax-book timing variances or indicative of unrecorded liabilities/revenue manipulation.
Expected_Result: Book Net Income on Tax Return ties exactly to Financial Statement Net Income; all book-to-tax reconciling items identified.
Common_Discrepancies: Book income on tax return does not match financial statements (indicating multiple sets of books); unsupported deductions; aggressive tax positions that could create pre-acquisition tax liabilities; failure to file in foreign/state jurisdictions.
Investigative_Steps: Inspect IRS filed tax return copies with e-file acceptance receipts; review tax accountant workpapers for Schedule M-3 adjustments; examine state apportionment factors.
Required_Supporting_Evidence: EVD-013 (Filed Form 1120/1065 with e-file receipts, Schedule M-3 workpapers, state tax returns)
Source_References: IRS Form 1120 Schedule M-3 Instructions; US GAAP ASC 740 (Income Taxes)

Reconciliation_Name: Deferred Revenue Schedule / Billing Waterfall to Balance Sheet Liability (SaaS)
Objective: Reconcile deferred revenue waterfall schedules (contracts, billings, revenue recognized, and closing deferred revenue) to the balance sheet deferred revenue account (ASC 606).
Source_Records_Required: SRC-019 (SaaS Billing & Deferred Revenue Waterfall Report), SRC-001 (TB), SRC-020 (Customer Master Subscription Contracts)
Fields_Or_Balances_Compared: Customer ID, Contract Start/End Dates, Total Contract Value (TCV), Annual Contract Value (ACV), Invoiced Amount, Monthly Recognized Revenue, Ending Deferred Revenue
Period_And_Entity_Coverage: Monthly for all historical periods across subscription tiers
Detailed_Procedure: Roll forward deferred revenue: Beginning Deferred Revenue + Billings - Revenue Recognized = Ending Deferred Revenue; compare ending deferred revenue to GL liability account 2-3000; verify revenue recognition timing against contract service dates.
Expected_Result: Deferred revenue subledger equals GL deferred revenue balance exactly (Variance == 0.00).
Common_Discrepancies: Upfront setup fees recognized immediately instead of amortized over customer life; unearned revenue not deferred upon invoicing; manual revenue acceleration entries near period end; multi-year contracts billed upfront without multi-period deferral tracking.
Investigative_Steps: Inspect signed Master Service Agreements (MSAs) and Order Forms; check billing system (Stripe/Chargebee/Zuora) webhook synchronizations to ERP; recalculate daily ratable amortization schedules.
Required_Supporting_Evidence: EVD-014 (SaaS contract billing schedules, Stripe/Chargebee transaction logs, customer subscription orders)
Procedure_Classification: Core QoE Mandatory Procedure (Specific to SaaS)
Source_References: US GAAP ASC 606 (Revenue from Contracts with Customers); Bessemer SaaS Metrics Guide

Reconciliation_Name: Goods Received Not Invoiced (GRNI) / Accrued Purchases Clearing Reconciliation
Objective: Reconcile physical inventory goods receipts recorded at warehouse docks to matching vendor bills and verify that open GRNI liabilities reflect genuine uninvoiced deliveries.
Source_Records_Required: SRC-009 (GRNI Open PO Subledger Report), SRC-008 (AP Ledger), SRC-001 (TB)
Fields_Or_Balances_Compared: PO Number, Vendor ID, Receiving Slip Number, Receipt Date, Quantity Received, Unit Purchase Price, Extended Received Value, Matched Invoice Date, Open Accrual
Period_And_Entity_Coverage: Monthly and at each balance sheet date for distribution and manufacturing entities
Detailed_Procedure: Extract open GRNI listing; match against GL clearing account 2-1050; age all open receipts by receipt date; identify receipts older than 60 days; test for goods returned to vendors without PO clearing; verify post-close invoicing.
Expected_Result: Active GRNI subledger matches GL clearing account; all open items represent valid unbilled deliveries <60 days old.
Common_Discrepancies: Aged GRNI balances that will never be invoiced (vendor never billed or billed under a different PO); duplicate receipts; goods returned to vendor without clearing inventory/GRNI; intentional under-recording of purchase costs.
Investigative_Steps: Inspect receiving dock logs and packing slips; check vendor statements for missing invoices; review post-period AP disbursements for late vendor billings.
Required_Supporting_Evidence: EVD-015 (Warehouse receiving dock receipts, electronic purchase order matching records, vendor confirmations)
Source_References: AICPA Audit Guide for Purchasing; RSM Transaction Advisory Practice

Reconciliation_Name: Manufacturing Cost of Goods Manufactured (COGM) & Overhead Absorption Reconciliation
Objective: Reconcile raw materials issued, direct labor incurred, and applied factory overhead to work-in-progress (WIP) and finished goods inventory additions and cost of sales.
Source_Records_Required: SRC-021 (Job Costing / Work Order Ledgers), SRC-022 (Factory Overhead Cost Ledgers), SRC-001 (TB)
Fields_Or_Balances_Compared: Work Order Number, Direct Material Cost, Direct Labor Hours & Cost, Applied Overhead, Standard Cost Variances, Finished Goods Transfer Value
Period_And_Entity_Coverage: Monthly and annual for manufacturing plants and assembly facilities
Detailed_Procedure: Compute Raw Materials Used = Beginning RM + Purchases - Ending RM; summarize Work Order charges (RM + DL + Applied OH); compute COGM = Beginning WIP + Manufacturing Charges - Ending WIP; compare Applied Overhead to Actual Overhead incurred to calculate under/over-absorbed overhead; trace variances to P&L.
Expected_Result: Work order costs roll cleanly into finished goods; overhead variances fully recognized in period P&L.
Common_Discrepancies: Over-absorption of fixed factory overhead during periods of high production capitalizing current-period opex into inventory; unposted scrap or material usage variances; labour efficiency variances buried in balance sheet WIP; incorrect standard cost BOMs.
Investigative_Steps: Inspect factory standard cost Bills of Materials (BOMs); verify direct labor time card allocations; audit plant overhead absorption formulas; review actual vs standard cost variance analysis.
Required_Supporting_Evidence: EVD-016 (Plant production run tickets, standard cost BOM cards, actual factory overhead spending ledgers)
Procedure_Classification: Core QoE Mandatory Procedure (Specific to Manufacturing)
Source_References: US GAAP ASC 330 (Inventory Costing); Alvarez & Marsal Manufacturing Operations Diligence
